stories.headline: US-Iran conflict widens further: Egypt officially confirms drone strike, new US-Saudi strikes on Iraqi militias, Senate narrowly fails to end US involvement
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (Egypt confirmation, Iraq PMF strikes, Senate vote); Single-reliable-source (Qeshm Island casualty detail, still unconfirmed by the West)
stories.one_line: Egypt's government officially confirmed Thursday's drone strike on its port (upgrade from this morning's single-source framing). New: US-Saudi strikes hit Iran-aligned PMF sites in Iraq (20 reportedly killed); Jordan's FM warned of a possible direct Israeli strike; the Senate narrowly failed (47-49) a War Powers resolution. Qeshm Island toll detail firmed (father, mother, 2-year-old killed) but remains sourced only to Iranian state media/Al Jazeera/MEE, not Western-confirmed. Forecast 2026-07-30-am-1 (4th-country strike or high-casualty event) trending toward realized, not force-resolved.
stories.score_note: Conflict footprint keeps broadening across multiple fronts simultaneously; highest-priority active thread.

stories.headline: Microsoft's rally becomes possibly the largest single-day market-cap gain ever; Meta's decline persists; L3Harris falls on IPO-delay news
stories.one_line: MSFT closed +15.56% ($451.57 vs $390.54 Wed close; day high $458.69, +17%), Bloomberg tracked an intraday market-cap gain of ~$490B as potentially the largest ever for a single stock; includes a confirmed $3.2B one-time gain on Microsoft's Anthropic equity stake. META closed -8.00%, continuing its post-earnings decline. New: L3Harris (LHX) fell 8.65% despite a beat-and-raise quarter, after delaying its missile-unit IPO to next year. Separately, Quanta Services (+17.3%), Huntington Ingalls (+14.2%) and Regeneron (+5.9%) all beat-and-raised; Altria (-8.5%) missed narrowly on EPS.
stories.score_note: Single biggest market story of the week; direct test case for AI-capex-reward-vs-punish framing continues into Apple/Amazon tonight.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance fetch

stories.headline: Russia launches a major missile/drone barrage on Ukraine overnight; a suspected Russian cruise missile crashes inside NATO member Poland
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (core event); Disputed (precise Ukraine casualty count, 8 vs 13 dead)
stories.one_line: Russia launched ~284 drones and 70 missiles (incl. 9 ballistic) at Ukraine overnight; Ukraine says it intercepted/suppressed most, with 11 missiles and 17 drones striking 20 locations. A suspected Kh-101 cruise missile crashed inside Poland near Tarnawa Kolonia/Biskupice; Polish PM Tusk and FM Sikorski attributed it to Russia, Polish jets scrambled. No formal NATO Article 4 consultation confirmed as invoked as of this report's cutoff.
stories.score_note: Direct NATO-territory security event, tracked independently of the Iran conflict; new forecast logged on Article 4 non-invocation.

stories.headline: Q2 2026 GDP prints 1.5%, a miss, as PCE inflation holds near 3.7%
stories.one_line: BEA's advance estimate: +1.5% annualized, down from Q1's +2.1%, missing most-cited consensus figures (1.8-2.3% range across providers). PCE inflation +3.7% YoY (down from 4.1% May). Forecast 2026-07-27-am-2 (1.0-2.5% range) resolves CORRECT; forecast 2026-07-30-am-2 (below-range print) resolves WRONG. GDPNow's final 1.5% nowcast matched the actual print almost exactly.
stories.score_note: Resolved; first hard data point after Wednesday's FOMC surprise, complicates rather than clarifies the policy outlook given weak growth alongside above-target inflation.

stories.headline: US chip stocks stage a sharp rebound, breaking a four-session losing streak
stories.one_line: Micron +18.4%, AMD +13.1%, Marvell +12.1% (this run's own data); wire coverage corroborates similar moves in Intel (~+13%), TSMC (~+7%) and Lam Research (~+17%), SOXX +8%+. Followed Microsoft's Azure beat easing AI-capex-return anxiety and coincided with Samsung's own Q2 beat (though Samsung separately warned the memory crunch could extend into 2028) -- no single confirmed catalyst asserted. Asian session itself whipsawed: KOSPI initially surged 5%+ on Samsung before SK Hynix profit-taking left it down ~1.23%.
stories.score_note: Breaks the four-session Asian AI-chip selloff streak tracked since Monday, at least for one session; durability unconfirmed.

stories.headline: Kumamoto death toll dispute widens rather than resolves: government cites 30, Japan Times/CBS cite 34, NPR cites 25
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple on each figure's existence; toll itself Disputed (25 vs 30 vs 34 across outlets)
stories.one_line: This morning's 23-34 range has not converged: PM Takaichi's government figure is 30, Japan Times/CBS report 34, NPR reports 25, Xinhua (citing Kumamoto prefecture) also reports 30. Sub-incident detail also conflicts (mall/mill death counts higher in NPR's account than this morning's tracked figures). A Nikkei Asia item claims TSMC/Toyota disruption and a Mitsubishi Electric halt, conflicting with this morning's framing; could not confirm if this is new information or a resurfaced older report.
stories.score_note: Toll dispute widening rather than resolving after 4 days is itself informative about incomplete on-the-ground accounting.

stories.headline: DRC Ebola: UN coordinator says 50 died in a single 24-hour period as case count passes 3,300
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (UN briefing); Single-reliable-source chain (DRC case-count figures)
stories.one_line: Cases/deaths updated to 3,360/1,487 (~Jul 29) from 3,262/1,437 (~Jul 27). UN senior Ebola coordinator Julien Harneis said 50 people died of Ebola in a single 24-hour period at a Bunia briefing, describing cases as 'doubling every 20 days.' New: WFP warns 10M people in eastern DRC are acutely food insecure ($2.1B appeal only 45% funded); a post-exposure preventive-treatment trial has reportedly begun (trial, not certified treatment).
stories.score_note: UN's own alarming trajectory characterization materially upgrades severity beyond the raw case-count trend.

stories.headline: Trump says he "may" pull Todd Blanche's AG nomination as Cornyn and Tillis withhold support over disputed IRS settlement
stories.one_line: Senate Judiciary postponed its vote on Blanche's AG confirmation. Sens. Cornyn and Tillis are withholding support over a DOJ settlement establishing a ~$1.776-1.8B 'anti-weaponization' fund and audit-immunity provisions tied to Trump's IRS lawsuit. Trump says he 'may' pull the nomination temporarily (keeping Blanche as acting AG) and wait until Cornyn/Tillis leave office before renominating.
stories.score_note: New intra-party standoff over a Cabinet-level nomination; watch for formal withdrawal or renomination.

stories.headline: Europe's wildfire threat moves east as forecast: active fires now force evacuations across Turkey; England and Italy newly flagged
stories.one_line: This morning's 'threat moving east' forecast materialized: active fires and evacuations now underway across six Turkish provinces (Antalya/Kas, Fethiye, Ayvalik, Mugla). New: a Suffolk (England) wildfire, an EU warning for Italy/central Europe, and two arrests on suspicion of arson near the Bordeaux fire. Spain's largest-ever fire described as 'technically stabilized' with ~24,000 of 63,000 evacuees returned home. Greece's toll (3 firefighters killed) unchanged.
stories.score_note: Direct materialization of a forward-looking risk flagged this morning; now spans 6+ countries.

Separately, a First Circuit panel reversed district-court TPS orders for South Sudan/Ethiopia citing SCOTUS's Mullin v. Doe ruling -- underlying facts confirmed via Congress.gov CRS/SCOTUS opinion, but 'rogue judges' framing in some coverage is partisan editorializing, not adopted here.
stories.score_note: Ongoing high-profile legal thread with an approaching deadline; new adjacent TPS ruling noted.
